en: The Group on Grasping, etc.; The Dyads on Root-Condition.

Dependent on a state that is both a cause and grasping (*upādāna*), a state that is neither grasping nor a cause arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are four; ... [as before] ... under the resultant condition (*vipāka*) there is one; ... [as before] ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are four.

Dependent on a state that is both a defilement (*kilesa*) and a cause, a state that is neither defiled nor a cause arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are four; ... [as before] ... under the resultant condition there is one; ... [as before] ... under the non-disappearance condition there are four. (Abbreviated.)
